ECC.name: SAP ECC 6.0
ECC.note: IS-U / FI-CA tables (simulated, representative names): EVBS/EANL premises and installations, EVER contracts, EGERH devices, EABLD meter read orders, EABL/EABLG reads, EABL_PLAUS VEE, ERCH/DBERCHZ billing, ERDK/ERDB invoices, DFKKOP items, DFKKZP payment lots, DFKKRP installment plans, DFKKWO write-offs, EMMACASE BPEM.

S4.name: SAP S/4HANA
S4.note: S/4HANA Utilities in IS-U / FI-CA shape (simulated): the same meter read order, read, VEE, billing, invoice, FI-CA, payment, installment plan, write-off and BPEM objects.

BW.name: SAP BW/4HANA
BW.note: Billing, FI-CA and payment ADSOs only (ZBILL_O01, ZFICA_O01, ZPAY_O01 style). No meter read orders, VEE, invoices, dunning detail or BPEM.

BDC.name: SAP BDC
BDC.note: Zero-copy SAP BDC data products: BusinessPartner and BillingDocument only. SAP BDC has no IS-U / FI-CA data products.

AMI.name: AMI head-end / MDM (Itron / Landis+Gyr style)
AMI.note: 15-minute interval reads with voltage and tamper / outage event flags per smart meter.

WEATHER.name: Weather and degree-day service
WEATHER.note: Daily heating and cooling degree days and temperature by territory.

CUSTOMER_ENGAGEMENT.name: Customer engagement platform + print vendor
CUSTOMER_ENGAGEMENT.note: Bill delivery (e-bill email, SMS, portal, print vendor mailing dates) and collection notices (SMS / email reminders, disconnect notices).

PAYMENTS_GATEWAY.name: Payments gateway (lockbox, aggregator, card, wallet, cash agent)
PAYMENTS_GATEWAY.note: Customer remittances outside SAP (AutoPay, card, Apple Pay / PayPal / Venmo, bill-pay aggregators, lockbox checks, cash agents), reconciled to FI-CA payment lots.

profiles.name: SAP SLT / direct replication
profiles.note: Native table and column names and types, as SAP SLT, Snowflake Openflow or a replication partner configured for native shape lands them. Today's bronze.

profiles.name: Fivetran
profiles.vendor: Fivetran (SAP ERP on HANA, SAP NetWeaver, SAP OData connectors)
profiles.note: Uppercase names; '/' in SAP namespaces becomes '_'. Adds _FIVETRAN_SYNCED; soft-delete mode adds _FIVETRAN_DELETED, history mode adds _FIVETRAN_ACTIVE/_START/_END, no-trigger mode _FIVETRAN_ID.

profiles.name: Qlik Replicate
profiles.vendor: Qlik Replicate / Qlik Cloud Data Integration (SAP Application, SAP HANA endpoints)
profiles.note: Native names. DATS/TIMS often land as text. Soft deletes via an operation_indicator column (default DELETE_FLAG = 'D'); Store Changes writes <table>__CT change tables with header__ columns, which are ignored.

profiles.name: Other ELT tool (configurable)
profiles.vendor: SNP Glue, Theobald Xtract, Informatica, AWS AppFlow, Azure Data Factory, ...
profiles.note: Set OPTIONS on CONFIG.INGESTION: table_prefix, audit_columns (regex), delete_column + delete_value, cast_text_types.
